label: August 3–9, 2026
intro: Pantomime hits Bangkok this weekend (Aug 8–9) with world-class performances and interactive kids workshops, and the NSM Brain Inside Out exhibition enters its final 10 days — don't leave either for next week.
weekday_note: Weekday Sub-Zero sessions (100 THB kids) are near-empty in August — best ice practice window of the month before school schedules tighten.

activities.title: Pantomime in Bangkok
activities.time: Check event listings for show times and workshop slots
activities.location: Muang Thai Life Assurance Auditorium, Ratchadaphisek Road, Bangkok
activities.price: Check event listings for ticket prices
activities.why: An international performing arts festival celebrating pantomime through world-class shows, interactive workshops, and artist discussions. Physical comedy and mime are irresistible for 5-year-olds — no language barrier, pure visual storytelling. The interactive workshops let kids try it themselves.
activities.tip: Book ahead — interactive workshop slots will be limited. A great alternative to another mall visit on a rainy August weekend.

activities.title: NSM Brain Inside Out — Last 10 Days
activities.date: Any day August 3–13 (closed Mondays; exhibition ends August 13)
activities.location: National Science Museum, Technopolis Khlong 5, Khlong Luang, Pathum Thani (~45 min north of Bangkok)
activities.price: Check nsm.or.th for current admission; children discounted
activities.why: Special exhibition 'Brain Inside Out' ends August 13 — interactive journey through how brains work from infancy onwards. Plus the main 6-floor Science Museum, Natural History Museum dinosaurs, and IT Museum. This is the final window before it closes.
activities.tip: Weekdays are quieter than weekends. Grab a Grab from BTS Paholyothin or drive. Full-day outing.

activities.title: ClassBento Kids Ceramic Workshop
activities.date: Book a weekend slot at classbento.co.th
activities.location: Multiple Bangkok studios (central BKK / Thonglor area)
activities.price: Check classbento.co.th for current session price
activities.why: Hands-on pinch pots, slabs, and coils for kids age 5+. Thor builds and decorates something from scratch and takes it home — same clay energy as the pottery classes he already loves. Available most weekends.
activities.tip: Book at classbento.co.th/ceramic-workshop-for-kids a few days ahead — weekend slots fill up fast.

activities.title: Mini Balloon Festival — Pranburi Beach Day Trip
activities.time: Balloon glow displays in the evening; daytime beach activities
activities.location: Lan Maharaj, Pak Nam Pran, Pran Buri District, Prachuap Khiri Khan (~3.5 hrs south of Bangkok)
activities.price: Free beachfront viewing; food and vendor stalls
activities.why: Colorful mini hot-air balloons, spectacular nighttime balloon glow displays, live music, and fresh seafood — all on a scenic beach. If Thor loves big colorful spectacles (he will), this is a magical overnight adventure to combine with Pak Nam Pran Beach.
activities.tip: Best as an overnight trip from Friday evening. Drive or take a bus from Southern Bus Terminal. Pairs nicely with the nearby Sun-Dried Squid & Seafood Festival (same weekend, same area).

activities.title: Sub-Zero Ice Skating — Weekday Session
activities.location: Sub-Zero Ice Skate Club, Major Cineplex Sukhumvit (Ekkamai BTS, skywalk access)
activities.price: 100 THB kids / 200 THB adults; skate rental included
activities.why: August weekday afternoons at Sub-Zero are blissfully quiet — two rinks, dedicated coaching area, and no weekend crowd. Perfect for building Thor's ice confidence at his own pace.
activities.tip: Wednesday discount: 90 THB/hr. A 60-min lesson (~900 THB) produces noticeable progress in one visit.

activities.title: Roller Dome Emporium — Weekend Session
activities.location: Roller Dome, Emporium Mall, Sukhumvit Soi 24 (Phrom Phong BTS)
activities.price: 150 THB/hr weekends; skates + protective gear included
activities.why: Regular rollerblading builds Thor's technique week on week. Dedicated beginner grass area and coaches on site. Good morning warm-up before the Pantomime afternoon show.
activities.tip: Sunday 10–11am is the quietest window of the week.
